query: Compare ERC Starting Grants with EIC Pathfinder for early-stage research. Which is better suited for what type of researcher?
response:
The **ERC Starting Grant (ERC-StG)** and **EIC Pathfinder** are both designed for early-stage work, but they serve fundamentally different purposes and target distinct career paths. ERC is focused on **individual scientific excellence**, while EIC Pathfinder is focused on **radical, deep-tech breakthrough potential** driven by a novel scientific concept.

Here is a detailed comparison:

### Comparison: ERC Starting Grant vs. EIC Pathfinder

| Feature | ERC Starting Grant (ERC-StG) | EIC Pathfinder | 
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Focus** | High-risk, high-gain **frontier research** driven by curiosity. | High-risk, high-gain **deep-tech breakthroughs** leading to new markets. |
| **Programme Pillar** | Pillar I: Excellent Science | Pillar III: Innovative Europe |
| **Target TRL** | **TRL 1-3** (Basic/Fundamental Research) | **TRL 1-4** (Fundamental Research leading to deep tech concept) |
| **Applicant Profile** | **Single Principal Investigator (PI)**, 2-7 years post-PhD. | **Consortium** (minimum 3 partners/3 countries) OR **Single Entity** (SME/research centre). |
| **Funding Rate** | 100% of eligible costs. | 100% of eligible costs. |
| **Typical Budget** | Up to **€1.5 Million** (5 years). | Typically **€3–€4 Million** (4 years). |
| **Evaluation** | Scientific Excellence of PI and Project (sole criterion). | Excellence, Impact, and Implementation (with emphasis on breakthrough potential). |
| **Success Rate** | Very competitive, approximately **10–15%**. | Highly competitive, but generally slightly higher than ERC for focused topics. |

***

### Suitability for Researcher Types

#### 🎯 Choose ERC Starting Grant if:

**The Ideal Applicant:** The outstanding, independent researcher (usually in academia/research institute) focused on **fundamental scientific questions** without a defined application or market goal.

*   **Your Goal:** To establish your research team's independence, reputation, and explore a major scientific or scholarly challenge (in **any field** of science, SSH, or engineering).
*   **Your Project:** Is pure discovery research. It may not lead to a product but promises a major advance in human knowledge.
*   **Consortium:** You operate as a **monobeneficiary** (you and your host institution), hiring your own team members.
*   **Eligibility:** You must have successfully defended your PhD 2 to 7 years prior to the call.

#### 💡 Choose EIC Pathfinder if:

**The Ideal Applicant:** A research leader or innovator (often from a mix of academic/research institutes and SMEs) focused on developing a **radical scientific proof-of-concept** that has high potential to create a new market.

*   **Your Goal:** To transform a theoretical idea into a viable deep-tech concept (e.g., demonstrating a new material, computing paradigm, or biological process) and build a collaborative team to achieve this.
*   **Your Project:** Must be highly interdisciplinary and potentially disruptive, focusing on high TRL 1-4 experimentation to establish feasibility.
*   **Consortium:** You typically lead a **consortium of academics and industry partners** (Pathfinder Open) or apply as a single entity (Pathfinder Challenges) with a clear path toward technology demonstration.
*   **Eligibility:** Open to consortia or single entities, highly focused on the technology itself, not just the PI’s reputation.

***

### Actionable Resources

To find specific calls and further details:

🎯 **ERC Starting Grant Resources:**
• Visit the [ERC Grants Portal](https://erc.europa.eu/funding/starting-grants)
• Register on [EU Funding & Tenders Portal](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/home)
• Review the [ERC Work Programmes](https://erc.europa.eu/apply-grant/scientific-council-work-programmes)

🎯 **EIC Pathfinder Resources:**
• Visit the [EIC Work Programme](https://eic.ec.europa.eu/eic-work-programme-2024-and-beyond_en)
• Search calls on [EU Funding & Tenders Portal - EIC](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/opportunities/topic-search;callCode=EIC) (Filter by 'EIC Pathfinder')
• Check eligibility via [How to Participate](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/how-to-participate/1)
